post.description: Same 401 message for missing account and incorrect password. Refresh token is returned only here and on rotation.
Every successful refresh consumes its token. Reuse revokes the entire login family. Clients must serialize refreshes.
Unknown/already revoked well-formed tokens return 204. Existing access JWTs remain valid until expiry.
